proxy_disclosures.collect_count: TikTok video favorite/collect counter (`collect_count`). Distinct from Instagram Insights `saves`; retained as an explicit proxy metric and never silently pooled with Instagram saves.

day30_pre_pub_chronological.calibration_note: Chronological 85/15 fit/calibration split with strict timestamp boundary (fit_max=2024-09-20 18:23:13+00:00, cal_min=2024-09-20 18:23:15+00:00).
limitations: TikTok creator_total_favorited and follower_count reflect creator snapshot metadata and can correlate across videos from the same account.
Creator-grouped splits are substantially harder than random/within-creator splits because creator baseline scale is unseen.
Empirical 90% prediction bands are split-residual approximations without finite-sample conformal exchangeability guarantees under distribution shift.

Small test sample size yields wide confidence intervals on per-class F1.
